items.source: The default transformation simply strips leading and trailing slashes as well as the file extension of the URI, and returns the result as the view name with the configured prefix and a suffix added as appropriate.
items.translation: 默认转换会简单地剥离 URI 的前导和尾随斜杠以及文件扩展名，并将结果作为视图名称返回，同时根据情况添加配置的 prefix 和 suffix。

items.source: The stripping of the leading slash and file extension can be disabled using the stripLeadingSlash and stripExtension properties, respectively.
items.translation: 可以使用 `stripLeadingSlash` 和 `stripExtension` 属性分别禁用前导斜杠和文件扩展名的剥离。

items.source: Can be explicitly defined as the viewNameTranslator bean in a DispatcherServlet context. Otherwise, a plain default instance will be used.
items.translation: 可以显式地将其定义为 `viewNameTranslator` Bean，在 DispatcherServlet 上下文中。否则，将使用普通的默认实例。

items.source: Find below some examples of request to view name translation.
items.translation: 以下是查看名称翻译请求的一些示例。

items.source: Set the value that will replace '/' as the separator in the view name. The default behavior simply leaves '/' as the separator.
items.translation: 设置将替换视图名称中 `/` 的值的分隔符。默认行为仅保留 `/` 作为分隔符。

items.source: Translates the request URI of the incoming HttpServletRequest into the view name based on the configured parameters.
items.translation: 将传入的HttpServletRequest的请求 URI 转换为视图名称，基于配置的参数。

items.source: Set the prefix to prepend to generated view names.
items.translation: 设置要附加到生成的视图名称的前缀。

items.source: Set the suffix to append to generated view names.
items.translation: 设置要附加到生成的视图名称的后缀。

items.source:
Transform the request URI (in the context of the webapp) stripping
slashes and extensions, and replacing the separator as required.
items.translation: 转换请求 URI（在 Web 应用程序的上下文中），剥离斜杠和扩展名，并根据需要替换分隔符。

items.source:
Set whether leading slashes should be stripped from the URI when
generating the view name. Default is "true".
items.translation: 设置是否在生成视图名称时从 URI 中剥离前导斜杠。默认值为"true"。

items.source:
Set whether trailing slashes should be stripped from the URI when
generating the view name. Default is "true".
items.translation: 设置是否在生成视图名称时从 URI 中删除尾随斜杠。默认值为"true"。

items.source:
Set whether file extensions should be stripped from the URI when
generating the view name. Default is "true".
items.translation: 设置是否在生成视图名称时从 URI 中剥离文件扩展名。默认值为"true"。

items.source: getViewName in interface RequestToViewNameTranslator
items.translation: `getViewName` 接口 `RequestToViewNameTranslator` 中

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if neither a parsed RequestPath, nor a String lookupPath have been resolved and cached as a request attribute.
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果既没有解析并缓存为请求属性的已解析 RequestPath，也没有 String lookupPath。

items.source: prefix - the prefix to prepend to generated view names
items.translation: prefix - 附加到生成的视图名称前面的前缀

items.source: suffix - the suffix to append to generated view names
items.translation: suffix - 要附加到生成的视图名称的后缀

items.source: lookupPath - the lookup path for the current request, as determined by the UrlPathHelper
items.translation: lookupPath - 当前请求的查找路径，由 UrlPathHelper 确定。

items.source:
the transformed path, with slashes and extensions stripped
if desired
items.translation: 转换后的路径，可根据需要去除斜杠和扩展名

items.source: Set the value that will replace '/' as the separator in the view name.
items.translation: 将用作视图名称中分隔符的值设置为替换 '/' 的内容。

items.source:
Set whether file extensions should be stripped from the URI when
generating the view name.
items.translation: 设置是否在生成视图名称时从 URI 中剥离文件扩展名。

items.source:
Set whether leading slashes should be stripped from the URI when
generating the view name.
items.translation: 设置是否在生成视图名称时从 URI 中剥离前导斜杠。

items.source:
Set whether trailing slashes should be stripped from the URI when
generating the view name.
items.translation: 设置是否在生成视图名称时从 URI 中删除尾随斜杠。

items.source: request - the incoming HttpServletRequest providing the context from which a view name is to be resolved
items.translation: request - 提供用于解析视图名称上下文的传入 HttpServletRequest

items.source: the view name, or null if no default found
items.translation: 视图名称，或者如果未找到默认值则为null。
